title: Beef and Mushroom Dumplings
description: Hearty beef and mushroom dumplings in a rich and savory sauce, inspired by Russian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add dumplings and cook until they float to the surface, about 5 minutes.
Drain dumplings and add them to the pan with the beef and mushroom mixture.
Stir in velvety sauce and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
